hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */node_modules/*) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in */mobile/*.ts|*/mobile/*.tsx) npx prettier --write "$f" ;; *.vue) npx eslint --fix "$f"; npx stylelint --fix "$f" ;; *.ts|*.js) case "$f" in */mobile/*) : ;; *) npx eslint --fix "$f" ;; esac ;; *.css) npx stylelint --fix "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
